rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow (later-injured plaintiffs) and institutionally palatable while adopting the ordinary accrual rule tied to APA § 702 injury and Crown Coat’s review-availability logic. Thomas or Kagan are the main alternatives: Thomas to ground the holding in textualist/originalist accrual principles, and Kagan to craft a minimalist, administrable rule with remedial/"as-applied" limiting language to address repose concerns.
